_meta.purpose: Stage edits to idol-producer-web `public/data/groups.json` before merging into the main catalog.
workflow: Web Step 1 — Update group: discography, wiki_url, song_uids union, publishers, dates, etc. (see support/docs/skills/idol-database-refresh/SKILL.md).
Web Step 3 — Update group members: member_names, member_uids, member_count, past_member_* — same staging file.
Run `npm run data:merge-catalog` (merge also applies songs_update.json if populated). Review diff, trim this file afterward.
_meta.merge_rules_summary: `discography[]` merges by release `uid` (deep per-disc). Arrays like `member_uids` replace when present on the patch. `song_uids` unions (append-only unique). See support/scripts/mergeCatalogUpdates.mjs.
